m03.speaker: nii
m03.text: KB's party, Selasi's clipboard and Sarpong's ethics, all in one day? You're doing campus life on hard mode, {name}.

took.speaker: nii
took.text: Somebody borrowed my flat screwdriver without asking. Somebody who sleeps in this room. I'm just saying.

done.speaker: nii
done.text: So the phone guy got his phone? You're a good person, {name}. Strange, but good.

day.speaker: nii
day.text: Morning! The water came and went at six. You'll learn.

rest.speaker: nii
rest.text: Go and rest small, {name}. Tomorrow, lectures start for real.
